Syntax: restring <item> <field> <text>
              |
              |The RESTRING command allows you to rename your equipment by paying quest
              |points at a Restringer NPC. You must be in the same room as a mob flagged
              |with the 'restringer' flag to use this service.
              |
              |Available fields and costs:
              |  name        (100 qp) - Match-keyword for the item (wear <name>)
              |  short       (150 qp) - Display name in inventory (a [item])
              |  long        (200 qp) - Display name on the ground (A [item] lies here.)
              |
              |Restringing works only on items in your inventory or currently worn.
              |
